reply_text:
I told Ilse her dock is **Bay 30**. I replied in her DM thread.

I got the answer from her own DM with me rather than from gbrain. On 14 Oct she wrote that Bay 30 is her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups "from now on". That message is in a conversation she can see herself.

gbrain couldn't look up the note I saved for her. It refused the request, and the error says this connection isn't tied to any one member while the brain serves several people. So what I save in gbrain can't be looked up again until someone who runs the gbrain server fixes that. Their suggested fix is to tie the connection to one member (`gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`). Because I act for many members, the better fit is probably the setting that lists the people I may act for and names the right person on each request. I didn't try either change; both have to be made on the gbrain server.
